common_mistakes.why: A normal case may hide empty-input, duplicate-value, ordering, disconnected-input or off-by-one errors.
common_mistakes.fix: Add normal, boundary and invalid cases and state which inputs the implementation supports.

common_mistakes.problem: Guessing complexity from the code length.
common_mistakes.why: Loops, nested work, recursion, data structure operations and input properties determine the cost.
common_mistakes.fix: Count dominant operations as a function of input size and distinguish auxiliary memory from input storage.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating a code snippet as a complete production implementation.
common_mistakes.why: A teaching example often omits input validation, robust tests or special cases.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the linked exercise and local tests to extend it; record runtime assumptions and limitations.
